output:

instruction: Create public and private subnets
output:
<think>
This is asking us to create public and private subnets.
</think>
echo 'resource "aws_subnet" "public" { count = 2 vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id cidr_block = cidrsubnet(aws_vpc.main.cidr_block, 8, count.index) map_public_ip_on_launch = true } resource "aws_subnet" "private" { count = 2 vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id cidr_block = cidrsubnet(aws_vpc.main.cidr_block, 8, count.index + 10) }' > subnets.tf
